body:
Publish semantic Study review, authority, progression and diagnostics ports backed by the existing browser owners. Captured authority and locator guard review retention, recovery and the opening-evidence journal across storage and delivery boundaries.

A freshly generated ordinary attempt can recover an absent first journal append after a same-authority reconnect only when its page holds the attempt Web Lock, observed the transaction abort, and has not exposed the attempt to an online or phone aggregate or evidence send. The transaction checks retained journal/events and the phone aggregate before inserting original events. Exposure aborts a concurrent insertion; a newer ambiguous write invalidates older abort proof. Existing exposed, legacy, position, foreign or ambiguous captures remain held; old tabs do not follow the new lock protocol. The controller has not adopted these ports.

At source head `9fb47a70`, seven focused unit suites had 315 passing and three failing cases; the same failures reproduce on base `035e079f`. Whole-project typecheck reported the same 18 diagnostics as the base. Independent review found no new source blocker at the narrow component boundary.

At `ef1a4abc`, seven real Chromium IndexedDB/Web Locks cases passed with controlled transport. At exact head `6b7ccf670b9b68fdca3debdfed7610b78badccc6`, two real two-tab phone/rebind transaction orderings and an unmocked no-Web-Locks review through a persisted original receipt to a playable next card passed. Owned resources were cleaned and pre/post input manifests matched. The race harness controls bootstrap/checkpoint transport, does not run a historical client, and external build/cache provenance is not independently attested. Full integrated acceptance, disposition of baseline failures, and FE25 closure remain pending.


Integrated head `2bc7b688` includes the review-test fixture corrections, B27 and current main through `5a6f5721`. On its parent `48fdf431`, six focused unit files passed 301 cases, typecheck passed, and component/inventory checks passed. Two additional real-browser authority-switch cases at `2bc7b688` compile, pass typecheck, and are discovered; their browser execution is pending. Independent source review found no blocking issue in those cases. The full P14 8 queue / 7 native / 11 Chromium run passed at `b591f397`, an earlier integrated head. An attempt to run the FE25 browser selection at `b591f397` failed during image build when the host disk filled; zero cases ran. These earlier receipts do not qualify the current integrated head. Docker resources were reconciled and builds remain held pending disk capacity. Hosted CI and installation are not claimed.
